layers.process: Valley of the Kings: foreign adult EGP 750 (about A$19.47), student EGP 375 (about A$9.74), at A$1 = about EGP 38.51 (Central Bank of Egypt average market rate for USD on 4 November 2026, EGP 54.70 mid, crossed with the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = USD 0.7040). Open 6 am to 5 pm every day.

Karnak: the foreign ticket covering Karnak Temple and the Open Air Museum is adult EGP 600 (about A$15.58), student EGP 300 (about A$7.79); the Mut Temple at Karnak is a separate EGP 200 (about A$5.19) adult, EGP 100 student. Open 6 am to 5 pm.

laws.rule: Mummification Museum: Private photography is subject to the museum's ticket conditions. Commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash; tripods/monopods only for permitted commercial use. Do not touch exhibits/showcases. Food and drinks are excluded from galleries except small water bottles. Bags/luggage larger than 40 by 40 cm are excluded from galleries and directed to the cloakroom. Follow posted instructions; this is the museum's visitor policy, not a governorate-wide photography or luggage rule.

culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Mummification Museum / Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, for this museum only.
culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Within Mummification Museum, follow staff/signs, do not touch exhibits, and keep calls/other noise quiet. Appropriate attire is requested where stated; no specific head-covering or clothing-length rule is invented.
culture-and-protocol.photography_and_story_permissions: Private photography is subject to the museum's ticket conditions. Commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash; tripods/monopods only for permitted commercial use. The page asks visitors to refrain from photographing other visitors or staff because of personal rights; this is not rewritten as a universal criminal prohibition.
